title: finding(plugin-form): the master-detail form's Subtotal / Tax / Total stack prints a hard-coded `¥` whatever the amount field's or the tenant's currency
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site. `reach:` a named producer. objectstack's `examples/app-showcase` `showcase_invoice` has the header `tax_rate` field that `MasterDetailForm` reads by default. Its inline line grid (`showcase_invoice_line`, `inlineEdit: 'grid'`) carries a stored `amount: Field.currency(...)` with no fixed currency, so its amounts are in the tenant's currency. Together these switch on the document totals stack. Reach was not measured by a render; the stack's condition and its formatting were read from source.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11129 (objectui#11071), from the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings` (`5895386652`, third line). That PR's contract review (`5895604298`, ③ note c) confirmed the site as real and pre-existing, and left open whether the `¥` is intended. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The site (read at objectui `origin/main` `8a5ae3d63`)

- `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx:614`: ``const money = (n: number) => `¥${n.toLocaleString(displayLocale, …)}`;``. It feeds `md-subtotal`, `md-tax` and `md-grand-total` at `:751`, `:755` and `:759`.
- The stack shows when the header carries the tax-rate field (`taxRateField`, default `tax_rate`, `:1270`) and an entry has an `amountField` (`:610`). The `amountField` is authored or derived from the child object (`:917`).
- The digits already follow the display locale (objectui#9909). The currency sign follows nothing.

## Question for triage

The one pin, `packages/plugin-form/src/formFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx:137-138` (`/^¥1\.234,50$/` for de, `/^¥1,234\.50$/` for en), is a display-locale pin for the digit grouping. It carries the `¥` because that is what the stack printed, not because the sign was asked for; no card or ruling found says the stack is yen-only.

The currency family's rulings point one way: a currency amount shows its field's own currency, or the tenant's when none is fixed, never a constant. See objectui#10354 / objectui#10418 (grid), objectui#10423 (mobile card), objectui#10463 (dashboard) and objectui#10422 (`resolveFieldCurrency`). If triage inherits that direction, the fix is:
- format the totals through the amount field's resolved currency, using the same resolver the grid footer uses;
- move the 9909 pin's sign onto that currency;
- add a pin with a non-yen tenant.

If the yen sign is meant, this card closes as not planned with that ruling cited.

## Dedupe

The 1169-item objectui issue/PR cache (2026-09-29), grepped for `currency sign`, `currency symbol`, `hard-coded currency`, `¥`, `md-subtotal`, `displayLocale-9909` and `money()`: 21 hits. All are the grid, dashboard, mobile-card, fields or i18n currency family, or display-locale date cards. None names `MasterDetailForm`'s totals.
